transcript:
MARTIN: Well, onward and upwards. What's next? Any other doors?

[SFX: We hear David walk to the next room. He opens the door, and walks through.]

DAVID: Just a hallway... A really long one...

[SFX: We hear his footsteps as he starts down the hallway.]


MARTIN: Wishing you stayed in the cells now?

DAVID: Lil' bit, man. Lil' bit. 



DAVID: No doors... No windows...  If it wasn't for the flashlight I would be walking blind... Damn it...

[SFX: He walks on further...] 

DAVID: Nothing here. God knows where this ends up...

[SFX: He walks even further...]

DAVID: There's more graffiti on the walls here...

MARTIN: What's it say?

DAVID: It's damn weird... It says:
